name: Agent-Context-Harness
summary: Per-turn router that sends each user message to the current task, an existing parallel worker, or a new parallel full-agent session, to keep context clean instead of compacting.

prior_art.verdict: Core idea shipped in Claude Code Projects. Open gaps: explicit inspectable router with confidence and eval set, session-thread-subagent tree view, nesting, vendor-neutral harness.

next_step: L4 exit: ONNX int8 export + CPU latency bench of atbd-r3 (ModernBERT-base, Modal volume ai-training:/data/runs/atbd-r3-modernbert-full3ep/model). Publish dataset v0.2 (counterfactual pairs) to HF. L2 gold eval set from Daniel's transcripts. L1 passed 2026-10-24.

prior_art_local_classifier.verdict: Gap open: no harness or released model decides per turn new-session vs continue; Claude Code has only a time-based idle-return /clear hint (75+ min, v2.1.92).

decisions.decision: Classifier runs on local inference, not a per-turn API call
decisions.why: Haiku draft measured 3-5 s blocking latency per prompt; local is portable across harnesses

decisions.decision: Public synthetic training set Agent-Task-Break-Detector on HF
decisions.why: Harness-agnostic name and scope; synthetic so it can be public; real transcripts stay private

training_runs.verdict: best so far; test pair accuracy just under 0.80 bar
